seeded-volume.initializeCommand: docker run --rm -v claude-data:/v alpine sh -c "touch /v/.seed && echo '{\"seeded\":true}' >/v/claude.json && chown $(id -u):$(id -g) /v"

proxied.initializeCommand: docker run --rm -v container-env:/v alpine sh -c "printf http://10.0.0.5:3456 >/v/ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL && chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) /v"
